not_covered: New initial fallen orientations, weakened motors, terrain or impacts
Godot transfer, cross-engine equivalence, real time or release
qualification_economy: Ten torso-target controls join the complete 172-control contact gate, including 4800 exact legacy plan comparisons against frozen published source. Reuse native containment, capture, readers and eligibility. One fourteen-world full route precedes 224 compact worlds.
purpose: Compare 16 exposed anchor/sweep profiles with root-pivot and torso-edge virtual-rotation targets on their original four bodies each. Both fresh comparators run on every one of sixteen bodies. Retain all 224 twelve-second outcomes and unchanged progress/eligibility results.
coverage: Sixteen actual compiled body shapes, nominal actuators and fresh inverted starts
Ninety-six body/profile pairs; each original and slower variant shares body, start, horizon, poses, gains, slew and physical limits
Every body receives six original/slow pairs and both fresh comparators in one fourteen-world batch
All 1440 controller intervals and 7200 native substeps per world retained with compact outcome reconstruction
All paired contact, rotation, eligibility and joint-violation outcomes retained; partial-progress leads remain separate from recovery
selection_rationale: Preserve all sixteen exposed anchor/sweep profiles, their body assignments, poses, gains, clocks, braking and command limits. Compare two declared virtual torso pivots for each profile with 15, 30 or 60 degree lookahead, bounded ramps and zero or 2 cm rise. Torso box geometry keeps the virtual target above the floor; finite limb projection residuals remain visible.
discovery_signal_scope: Keep the five-degree gain over each body's fresh timed comparator and zero-joint-violation screen. Root/edge contrasts with the matched old profile are descriptive development evidence. Useful leads require fresh full-capture varied-start confirmation; no training or release qualification.
braking_model_limit: Constant-velocity lookahead and a stopping-speed envelope using a declared 6 rad/s^2 shaping estimate. This is not a validated physical deceleration bound or a guarantee that no joint crosses its limit.
contact_geometry_limit: Finite 25 by 25 normalized joint grid for each compiled two-joint limb and distal capsule on world y=0. The lower geometric capsule endpoint is retained after measured distal contact; it is not a measured contact point or force. Unreachable world targets keep their projection residual. No dynamic feasibility guarantee.
torso_target_limit: A virtual pose is used solely to select bounded joint targets. Neither the native root nor a body is reset, positioned or actuated directly. Torso collision clearance is geometric; contact force, dynamic feasibility, stable support and recovery are not guaranteed.
